attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **The same day's listing keeps a second Acepsimas**, the bishop of Naeson in Persia, whose folder the corpus already has and which is upgraded from its own page in this batch. The two are separate entries with separate pages: that one is a hieromartyr of the Persian persecution, this one a hermit of the fourth century under Theodosius the Great who died in peace, and the corpus's settled rule is that two entries on one calendar are two commemorations. The display name takes the day for that reason, since both men bear it. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
